n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.r.c: 3,000 won na price for three single ones, but she only need two oranges.

n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.explain: For two oranges, two singles (2,000 won) cheaper pass di pack (2,500 won). Minsu claim true for each orange, but e no match wetin Jisu need.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.prompt: Write 1-2 sentences of advice to Jisu (English or Korean). Use numbers from di sign as evidence.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.hint.0: Talk wetin Jisu need, then give di total for each way to buy am.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.hint.1: End with di way wey cost less for her.

n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.prompt: Imagine 수진 add ONE sentence to card. Which added sentences go settle teacher question? Choose all wey settle am (yes or no count).

n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.r.a: Many people from many countries study Korean, so this no tell country.

n-k-l1e-03.title: One word, three scenes
n-k-l1e-03.goal: Read same Korean word for three scenes wey dey grow, change its meaning as situation change, say wetin decide am, and use am correctly yourself.
n-k-l1e-03.material: Three short scenes between classmates 하나 and 민수 (na made up). Dem use polite -요 speech. Dem show one scene at a time.
n-k-l1e-03.thinking.1: Change interpretation when new information come
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.prompt: Same word show for three small scenes. Read each one and decide wetin e mean there before you see next.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.hint.0: Before you choose, read the line just before the word.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ask wetin the other person just do: ask, thank or apologize?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.info:
Scene 1. 하나 introduce her friend to 민수.

n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.after: When person answer yes-or-no question, 아니에요 mean ‘no’.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Nobody thank her, so no reason to say ‘you welcome’.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Nobody do anything wrong for this scene.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Nothing need forgiveness here; 민수 ask question.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.info:

민수: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.after: After 고마워요, 아니에요 na modest reply: ‘Nothing.’ Same word now answer thanks, no be question.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: No, I no lend you pen.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: He dey hold out the pen. This one read the word same as Scene 1 and ignore wetin 하나 just talk.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: He no get anything to apologize for.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.info:

민수: 죄송해요!
하나: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.after: After apology, 아니에요 mean ‘E dey okay, no worry.’ One word, three work: the line before am decide.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Nothing for scene show say she doubt am; after apology, the word comfort am.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: I no vex; e dey okay.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: He no thank her; he apologize.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.reflect: Your reading of 아니에요 change from one scene to another? Wetin you check to decide each time?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.prompt: Looking back the three scenes, wetin decide meaning of 아니에요 each time?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.hint.0: Compare wetin stay the same and wetin change for the three scenes.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.hint.1: Look at wetin come just before the word each time.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.o.a: The sound of the word 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.a: The word exactly the same each time, so e no fit be wetin change the meaning.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.o.b: The line dem talk just before am, and wetin just happen.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.o.c: Whether the speaker na man or woman.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.c: Men and women use the word all three ways.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.o.d: How loud dem talk the word.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.d: This task dey about written text; meaning here come from the words before.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.explain: The word no change. Meaning come from previous line: question (no), thanks (nothing) or apology (e dey okay).
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.prompt: Classmate tell you ‘고마워요!’ because you lend am pen. Reply for Korean (polite -요 speech) with modest ‘Na nothing’.

n-k-l1e-04.title: Who younger? Comparisons only
n-k-l1e-04.goal: Turn four everyday introductions wey only compare age into rule, make some correct age groups, greet politely with one, and find wetin true for all of dem.
n-k-l1e-04.material:
Four people meet for Korean class (all na made up). 민아 talk her age. The others only compare.

민아: 저는 20살이에요.
하나: 저는 민아 씨보다 어려요. 지호 씨보다 나이가 많아요.
선생님: 저는 민아 씨보다 나이가 많아요.
(지호 no talk anything about age.)

n-k-l1e-04.thinking.2: Wetin dey true in every case

n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.o.b: Hana younger than 민아; sentence no give number.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.r.c: 어려요 mean ‘young’. -보다 mean ‘than’, so Hana younger, no be older.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.r.d: If dem same age, nobody go say ‘어려요’.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.explain: ‘-보다 어려요’ make comparison, no be a number. Plenty ages fit.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.prompt: Everybody for class between 10 and 60. 민아 na 20. Make 3 different examples (j = 지호, h = 하나, t = 선생님) where every sentence true, and use different age for 하나 each time.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.hint.0: First put four people in order from youngest to oldest.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.hint.1: Choose 하나 age, then choose younger age for 지호 and older for 선생님.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.hint.2: Check every Korean sentence with your numbers one at a time.

n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.fail.c4: 선생님 talk say dem older than 민아, wey na 20.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.explain: The sentences only compare ages, so plenty fit: for example 12 < 15 < 20 < 35. Any number in right order go work.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Choose one of your examples. Write for Korean wetin 지호 go talk when he first meet 선생님: polite greeting and his age.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Start with polite greeting wey you know from first day for class.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Use your 지호 number plus 살 for his age.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: The age I write match 지호 number for my example?
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.prompt: Which statement true for EVERY correct example, no be only yours?
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.hint.0: Write your three examples side by side and see wetin no change.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.hint.1: Follow the chain from youngest to oldest person.

n-k-l1f-01.title: We fit order lunch set?
n-k-l1f-01.topic: Order food: menus with hidden conditions
n-k-l1f-01.goal: Read short menu sign, choose facts wey decide if you fit order, apply dem to real case, and ask clerk polite question about wetin still dey available.
n-k-l1f-01.material:
For restaurant entrance, you read this sign. The set na Korean lunch special.

[점심 세트]

n-k-l1f-01.thinking.0: Tell relevant information from irrelevant one
n-k-l1f-01.thinking.1: Check all conditions true at the same time

n-k-l1f-01.prereq.2: Know 주문 and 세트 from sign
n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.prompt: You and friend wan eat 김치찌개 세트 for lunch. Before you leave, which facts you must check against sign to know if you fit order? Choose all wey apply.

n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.r.b: This tell you wetin you go get. E no be rule for ordering.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.o.c: How many people dey chop together
n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.o.d: Wich day of di week e be
n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.r.d: Di sign no mention any day.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.explain: Di sign get two conditions: di time (12 to 2) and di group size (two people or more). Di drink, di money and di seat no be conditions.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.prompt: You and one friend reach di restaurant for 두 시 십 분 (2:10). Una fit order di 김치찌개 세트?

n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.r.c: Di sign talk di opposite: na for two people or more.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.o.d: Yes. Lunch sets dey usually continue small after time, so you still fit order am.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.r.d: Di sign talk say e end for 2 o'clock. No assume say dem go add time.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.explain: Di group condition dey okay (two people), but di time condition no dey: di sign talk 12:00 to 2:00, and time don reach 2:10. Both rules must follow.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s3.prompt: Di set time don pass. Politely ask di server for Korean (one short question): wetin you fit order now, or dem get another menu?

n-k-l1f-02.title: Five cups for di office
n-k-l1f-02.goal: Turn one short message to exact conditions, find some orders wey meet all of dem, and report one for Korean.
n-k-l1f-02.material:
Your friend text you before you go café:

"커피도 주스도 사 와요. 모두 다섯 잔이에요. 돈은 만 삼천 원 있어요."

Words: 커피도 주스도 = both coffee and juice (some of each); 모두 = all together; 돈 = money; 있어요 = you get.
